Published online:
August 25, 2026

Geographic focus:
United States (Federal Reserve regional districts: Dallas, Cleveland, Minneapolis, Kansas City)

Temporal focus:
T1. Historical observation [YES] — Reports on July 28-29 meeting decisions and discount rate votes already cast
T2. Forward-looking immediate [YES] — Signals hawkish internal pressure heading into near-term Fed meetings
T3. Longterm development [NO]

Synopsis:
Four Federal Reserve regional bank boards (Dallas, Cleveland, Minneapolis, Kansas City) voted to raise the discount rate by 25bps ahead of the July meeting, where the FOMC ultimately held policy rates unchanged in a 9-3 vote. The policy rate remains at 3.5%-3.75% since December. The dissent reveals meaningful internal hawkish pressure within the Fed, despite the hold decision prevailing.
